import React from 'react'; import { dataService } from '../services/dataService.js'; export default function OrderDetailModal({ order, onClose, onInspectMap }) { if (!order) return null; const bookingDate = dataService.constructor.parseDate(order.BookingTime); return (

Trip Journey Details

Trip #{order.OrderID}

{order.City} • {bookingDate ? bookingDate.toLocaleString() : 'N/A'}
{order.delivery?.DeliveryStatus}
CUSTOMER
{order.customer?.Name}
{order.customer?.Phone}
{order.customer?.CustomerType} Tier
DRIVER & VEHICLE
{order.provider?.Name || 'Not Assigned'}
{order.provider?.VehicleNumber || 'N/A'}
{order.provider?.Phone || ''}
Pickup Location 🟢 {order.PickupLocation?.Area || 'N/A'}
Drop Destination 🏁 {order.DropLocation?.Area || 'N/A'}
Distance Traveled {order.delivery?.DistanceKm || 0} km
Vehicle Type {order.VehicleType}
Payment Mode {order.delivery?.PaymentMode || 'N/A'}
Total Fare Paid ₹{order.delivery?.PaymentAmount || 0}
); }
